claim: On FlowCAP-II (d=7), IDD has F1 approximately 0.75 and ARL1 approximately 1, versus Hotelling T2 F1 below 0.4.
domain: The camera-ready FlowCAP-II experiment and the original figure shipped in arXiv source 2602.07252.
assumptions: The original PNG is the numerical display supporting the prose claim.
The right ARL1 axis is logarithmic, exactly as labelled.
A value called approximately 1 must be no greater than 1.5, a deliberately generous 50% tolerance.
quantifier: Every displayed IDD operating point is described as near-immediate, and the caption claims lowest ARL1 across the full ARL0 range.
falsification_rule: FALSIFIED if every displayed IDD ARL1 marker exceeds 1.5 after calibrated log-axis digitization.
scope_limit: This can falsify the paper's reported numerical clause but cannot verify the unreleased raw-data pipeline.
